info.name: Send account-level batch events and traits

params.name: publicApiKey
params.description: Your Koala workspace public API key

items.docs: Ingests a batch of identify calls (traits) and/or events associated with a company account rather than an individual visitor. Each request must include either an `account_id` or `domain`. Koala will create a new Account automatically if the domain has not been tracked before. Use the optional `group_id` inside each identify to disambiguate multiple tenants sharing the same domain.
